title: After 13 yrs, Borivali’s Bhagwati Hosp set to reopen from July 2027

ai.summary: After 13 years, Mumbai's Bhagwati Hospital is set to reopen in July 2027 following a protest by Shiv Sena (UBT) leader Aditya Thackeray against its proposed public-private partnership model.

facts.claim: After 13 years, Mumbai's Bhagwati Hospital is set to reopen in July 2027
facts.quote: After 13 yrs, Borivali’s Bhagwati Hosp set to reopen from July 2027

facts.claim: Following a protest led by Shiv Sena (UBT) leader Aditya Thackeray outside the hospital on November 16 against its proposed public-private partnership (PPP) model
facts.quote: Following a protest led by Shiv Sena (UBT) leader Aditya Thackeray outside the hospital on November 16 against its proposed public-private partnership (PPP) model

facts.claim: The hospital was shut in 2013 after being declared dilapidated
facts.quote: the hospital was shut in 2013 after being declared dilapidated

facts.claim: Patients were shifted to Shatabdi Hospital in Kandivli
facts.quote: its patients were shifted to Shatabdi Hospital in Kandivli

facts.claim: The hospital will have MRI, CT scan, cath lab, blood centres, burns wards and a 20-bed neonatal ICU
facts.quote: Once renovated, Bhagwati Hospital will have MRI, CT scan, cath lab, blood centres, burns wards and a 20-bed neonatal ICU

ai.background_note: The hospital was closed in 2013 due to being declared dilapidated and patients were shifted to Shatabdi Hospital, which has since become overwhelmed with patients from across Mumbai and beyond.
